scope.summary: Author the glute channel group per Section 13.17 (BK-17.3, TAI-BK-044), closing REQ-012: glute_volume (round ass as its own channel), glute_roundness, glute_lift, glute_width, hip_dip_fill, glute_crease_sharpness — all Tissue channels over the glute_l/r masks, independent of every thigh channel and of hip_bone_width, with multi-key tracks supporting over-range volume.
acceptance_criteria: Channels glute_volume (design_max 3.0, keys 0/50/100/200/300), glute_roundness, glute_lift, glute_width, hip_dip_fill, glute_crease_sharpness registered as Tissue, group_key 'glute', masks glute_l+glute_r, each with L/R asymmetry sub-channels.
Full-range sweeps of every glute channel pass BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID: zero displacement on thigh masks, hip skeletal mask, and all other regions.

Round-ass + narrow-thighs reachability (REQUIRED combo per TAI-BK-045 interplay): glute_volume=3.0 + glute_roundness=1.0 with thigh girth channels at min (fixture until MT-503) evaluates artifact-free with mesh-quality assertions in the glute/thigh crease area.
glute_crease_sharpness at extremes does not produce self-intersection at the crease (dedicated fixture assertion).
All six channels API-addressable; volume-class over-range rejection above design_max verified.
scope.risk_if_missed: Round ass with narrow thighs is an operator-required reachable combo (OBR-003/OBR-004); if glute volume drags thigh girth the way Daz glute morphs do, a core production archetype is unreachable and the glute/thigh crease becomes a permanent sculpt-fix zone.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Separate control independence from declared feathered deformation support, skeletal propagation, physical response, and explicit coupling.
